dek: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has expressed deep condolences to China following deadly flash floods and landslides in the country’s border region. The disaster caused loss of life and left several people missing. In a post on X, the prime minister expressed grief and solidarity with the Chinese people. Pakistan Offers
